summary_bullets: Make design-log final publish idempotent after squash merges without reusing pause branches
Protect publish-tail result env and final summaries from concurrent failure clobbers
Force stdout authority for plan-write and validator failures so stale success files cannot mask them
commit_message:
Protect design publish retries from stale failure clobbers

Detect remote design-log branches for every publish reason while keeping final publishes based on origin default. Add final idempotent success for squash-merged logs when the remote log branch is gone.

Serialize design publish result-env writes, preserve existing publish-tail success metadata, and avoid failed-publish summary rewrites after a success is recorded.

Make Step 5c trust stdout for plan-write failures and validator defects so stale result env success cannot mask current failures.
